title: Cask Test - 1978
channel: miSci - museum of innovation and science
summary: Archival 1978 Sandia footage testing shipping containers for spent nuclear fuel, including trucks ramming walls, a locomotive hitting a truck-borne cask and a rocket-propelled train crash, plus a fire test.
why: Cited in nuclear power threads as proof that waste casks survive severe crashes.

quote.text: If a nuclear waste cask gets hit by planes, trains, or automobiles, not much will happen.
